currency: USD, nominal 2026; taxes excluded symmetrically, pre-tax project results
scope: All buyers, contracts, collections, financing and labor allocations are simulated. The digital construction and local verification are executed. No customer willingness-to-pay or campaign invoice is observed.
labor_reference: BLS May2025 electronics-engineer wage USD130220; divided by2080 and illustrative full-time compensation share0.685 gives USD91.4/h before specialist/business overhead. USD135/h is an estimate, not an observed quote.
buyer_value_warning: Value, demand, fit, payment behavior and trust costs are explicit model inputs. AI-generated buyer choices are not willingness-to-pay evidence.
model_routing: Hypothetical production route: low-cost Terra for schema/administration, Astra for ambiguous specification/challenge, deterministic compiler+oracle+Yosys for delivery checks. USD25/order inference allowance is conservative allocation, not measured model billing. This campaign was authored by available Astra agents; no randomized model-routing comparison was run.
